issues.legal_issue: Whether the High Court erred in refusing specific performance on the ground that performance would cause hardship to the defendants, where the hardship was not shown to have been unforeseen when the contract was made.
Whether the High Court could reverse the trial court’s specific-performance decree on hardship without framing and deciding an issue on that question.
Whether the trial court’s finding that the plaintiff was ready and willing to perform the contract remained undisturbed.
Whether the balance consideration payable for specific performance should be increased in view of the circumstances of the defendants.
